agent_note: First-person present-tense narration, apparently multiple narrators (a wife/ex-wife strand and a law-enforcement strand). 21 event quotes, 17 present / 4 past (81% present); the past minority is entirely backstory/recollection - the first husband Adam, the marriage to Bob, motherhood - so this fits METHODOLOGY's 'Present + recollection strand' row (80-85% band, flag for audit). Heavy gnomic load (16 of 42): this book is extremely aphoristic and a two-bucket filter would badly inflate its present-tense evidence. Quotation marks survive well in this book, so dialogue was set by mark-majority except q10041, set by direct-address/register. Several quotes are proverb-plus-scene composites (q10015, q10019, q10031, q10047, q10048, q10053) and were bucketed on their anchoring finite clause.
